title: Bounded current-time acquisition
statement: The authority must obtain current time for a declared domain from a host-supplied time source within a bounded, explicit interval, and must report failure distinctly when the source is unavailable or returns an out-of-bounds value.

source.reference: packet.md (obtains bounded current time); interface-bridge.md; anchors: XVE-SYS-0147, FR-015

applicability: xverse::xcom::validation time authority; deterministic injectable source for tests.
verification_intent: Unit: inject a deterministic source and assert domain attribution; inject failure and out-of-bounds sources and assert distinct failures.
acceptance_criteria: A valid read returns a timestamp attributed to the requested domain only.
A source failure or out-of-bounds value yields a distinct deterministic failure, not a guessed value.
Reads never fabricate time nor silently fall back to another domain.
